meta.disclaimer: Facts come from each provider's own public page on the last-checked date. Prices, dates and availability change, and some entries show the prior season's published rate. Always confirm with the provider. Listing here is not an endorsement, and we have not inspected, licensed, or safety-vetted any program.
meta.geography_focus: Metro Atlanta, Cobb County first (Marietta, East Cobb, Smyrna, Kennesaw, Acworth, Powder Springs), plus North Fulton, Atlanta/DeKalb and Gwinnett
meta.age_fields: age_min/age_max are numeric years taken from the provider's published ages or grades (grade + 5); null when the provider publishes no range.
meta.planner_fields: hours_start/hours_end/before_care/after_care are 24h 'HH:MM' strings copied from the provider page only when unambiguous, else null; hours_year says which season those hours were published for (null = general). sessions is a list of {start,end} ISO dates for announced 2027 summer sessions only (null when not announced). summer=true for summer camps; overnight=true for sleepaway camps. reg_dates is a list of {date,label} for announced sign-up dates copied from the registration text (null when none is announced); used by My camp calendar and its .ics feed, and check_weekdays.py verifies each date appears in the registration text.
